description: This dataset lists active solid waste management facilities regulated by the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation, published on the state open data portal. Each row is a facility activity with facility name, address, county, DEC region, owner name and type, activity description and number (for example landfill, transfer facility, recycling, composting, construction and demolition debris processing, scrap metal processing, household hazardous waste or regulated medical waste), active flag, coordinates with an accuracy code, waste types, and authorization number, issue date and expiration date for the permit or registration. The portal provides an overview and a data dictionary as PDF attachments, and the table is free to download as CSV, JSON and other formats or to query through the Socrata API; it is posted annually, with the last row update in April 2026. The portal metadata read does not name a licence. Caveats: the table covers active authorizations only, some locations are approximate, and facility capacities are not included. Simulation uses: building a statewide waste facility network with regulatory status for disaster debris and waste flow models, and checking which facilities lie in flood or storm exposure zones. Related records: the EPA Facility Registry Service (data-epa-facility-registry-service) links facilities across federal programmes.
